Choose an event list

Open the group you need.

Switch between all or active events, pending items, invitations, your events, drafts, and trash. Use Explore for public events or the plus button to create one.

Read an event card

See the key details at a glance.

The card shows the event image, title, time, place, and organizer. A badge such as 1 / 5 shows accepted people against capacity, while a red number marks pending items.

People and actions

Open members or the actions available to you.

Tap the capacity badge to see participants and pending people. The three-dot menu changes with your role and the event state, so it may offer viewing, editing, publishing, invitation handling, sharing, leaving, deleting, or restoring.

Join an event

The steps depend on the event settings.

You can accept or reject an invitation from its card. Some events confirm you immediately; others require approval, a ticket, accepted rules, payment, or choices before your place is final.

Create or host

Start simple and add details when needed.

The plus button opens the event editor. You can create a basic meetup or add sub-events, groups, resources, tickets, pricing, and capacity rules.

Complete the information used on your profile.

Details and visibility

Add optional details and choose who can see them.

Add experience, lifestyle, values, and interests as needed. The header controls the overall profile status, while visibility icons beside supported details choose Public, Friends, Hosts, or Private.

Use the checkmark when you are finished.

The checkmark saves your changes and closes the editor. Closing the main panel without saving does not submit the changes.

Choose an event list

Open the group you need.

Switch between all or active events, pending items, invitations, your events, drafts, and trash. Use Explore for public events or the plus button to create one.

Read an event card

See the key details at a glance.

The card shows the event image, title, time, place, and organizer. A badge such as 1 / 5 shows accepted people against capacity, while a red number marks pending items.

People and actions

Open members or the actions available to you.

Tap the capacity badge to see participants and pending people. The three-dot menu changes with your role and the event state, so it may offer viewing, editing, publishing, invitation handling, sharing, leaving, deleting, or restoring.

Join an event

The steps depend on the event settings.

You can accept or reject an invitation from its card. Some events confirm you immediately; others require approval, a ticket, accepted rules, payment, or choices before your place is final.

Create or host

Start simple and add details when needed.

The plus button opens the event editor. You can create a basic meetup or add sub-events, groups, resources, tickets, pricing, and capacity rules.

A row shows the latest sender, channel, recent message, time, member count, and unread count. Tap it to open the conversation.

Channel types

Keep each conversation in the right place.

Event chats cover the whole event, sub-event chats cover one part, and group chats cover a smaller team. Service and App Support chats handle their own help or system-related topics.

Open a conversation

Read messages and use the available actions.

The header opens members, the related event or group, and pinned messages. Message actions depend on ownership and content: you may reply, react, edit or unsend your own message, pin it, open an attachment, or report it.

Send more than text

Use chat tools for practical planning.

The plus button lets you add an image, voice clip, poll, event, or asset. Shared items stay in the conversation so participants can open them later.
